title: WinUI IR WAV load entry point
claims: Formal WinUI shell exposes an explicit file picker entry point that calls the existing PrepareIrAsync contract.
Compatibility Preview mirrors the same entry point through the shared code-behind handler.
Bypass mode, missing or oversized files and a disconnected engine remain fail-closed with existing ViewModel status text.
non_claims: No physical sink, audible playback, driver install/load, HLK or Microsoft signing evidence is claimed.
The prepare Ack is not a graph commit or physical audio delivery.
